River restoration

Help Tools
ContentsHistoryMethods

River restoration returns a damaged river toward a more natural structure and function.

Projects often reconnect a channel with its floodplain and improve habitat for fish and plants.

History

Modern restoration grew from efforts to reduce erosion while keeping waterways useful to nearby communities.

Methods

  • Remove barriers that block seasonal fish movement.
  • Plant native vegetation along the banks.
